_about: SHELF of the Fables of Bidpai (Kalilah and Dimnah, the Panchatantra's travels west) in English before 1931: Keith-Falconer's Syriac Kalilah and Dimnah (1885), Sir Thomas North's Morall Philosophie of Doni (1570, in Jacobs's 1888 reprint), and the Persian Anvar-i Suhaili in Eastwick's (1854) and Wollaston's (1877) translations. Ryder's Panchatantra is on the ryder shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 77); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. 'north' alone is left out as a common word.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
